code: import axios from'axios';const API_BASE_URL=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL||'http://localhost:5000/api';const api=axios.create({baseURL:API_BASE_URL,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}});api.interceptors.request.use(config=>{const token=localStorage.getItem('token');if(token){config.headers.Authorization="Bearer ".concat(token);}return config;});export const authAPI={login:(email,password)=>api.post('/auth/login',{email,password}),register:(username,email,password)=>api.post('/auth/register',{username,email,password}),verifyToken:token=>api.get('/auth/verify',{headers:{Authorization:"Bearer ".concat(token)}})};export const storiesAPI={getStories:function(){let page=arguments.length>0&&arguments[0]!==undefined?arguments[0]:1;let limit=arguments.length>1&&arguments[1]!==undefined?arguments[1]:10;return api.get("/stories?page=".concat(page,"&limit=").concat(limit));},getStory:id=>api.get("/stories/".concat(id)),toggleBookmark:id=>api.post("/stories/".concat(id,"/bookmark")),getBookmarks:()=>api.get('/stories/bookmarks')};export const scrapeAPI={scrape:()=>api.post('/scrape')};
